title: Hospitality Wednesdays
description: Midweek games, 2-for-1 pizzas, tapas and local drinks offers.
detail: Games: Jenga, Uno, giant Connect 4, cards, gladiator duelling and more. 2-for-1 pizzas, tapas £4 each. Drinks: Carling, Shipyard & Somersby £2.88; 2 WKDs £5.50; Corky’s 4 for £5; 4 shots/bombs £10; vodka mixer £3.50; 2 cocktails for £10.

title: Tom’s Tipsy Karaoke
description: Take your turn on the mic. Weekly karaoke from 7pm.
detail: Every Wednesday from 7pm, on the back of Hospitality Wednesdays. Bring a friend, pick a song and get involved.

title: Betty Bangs
description: A weekly drag-hosted bingo and karaoke night until late.
detail: Betty Bangs hosts bingo and karaoke every Thursday from 8pm until late.

title: Thursday Karaoke
description: Get the gang together for karaoke, every Thursday night.
detail: Every Thursday from 9pm. Find The Crew & Queens Hall on Queens Road.

title: Feel Good Fridays
description: DJ Macca brings R&B, house, club classics and party anthems.
detail: The one and only DJ Macca, every Friday 8pm right through till 3am. R&B, house, club classics and party anthems all night long.

title: Saturday Disco
description: Floor fillers and favourite tunes, every Saturday night.
detail: Floor fillers, absolute bangers and all your favourite tunes. Every Saturday 7pm till late.

title: Silky Saturdays
description: DJ Baxter, cocktails and a dancefloor ready for the weekend.
detail: DJ Baxter from 8pm with big tracks and big energy. Cocktails, shots, bottles and pints flowing all night. Until late.

title: Halloween Party
description: DJ Kish brings monster tunes and spooky bangers. Fancy dress encouraged.
detail: Saturday 31 October. DJ Kish is in the house with spooky bangers and dancefloor anthems all night. Fancy dress encouraged, with a prize for the best dressed.

title: Bingo
description: An hour of bingo at Piero Lounge, 7pm–8pm.
